title: OpenAI launches GPT‑5.4 mini and nano, promising faster and cheaper coding workflows - The Hindu
summary: OpenAI launched its GPT-5.4 mini and nano models, aimed at improving coding workflows with faster and more cost-effective solutions. These models are designed for high-volume workloads and are tailored for tasks requiring quick responses and reliable tool use.
sentiment_reason: The announcement of new AI models by OpenAI is generally neutral to slightly negative for the tech sector as it indicates increased competition and potential market shifts, but it does not directly imply a market crash or sanctions.
